proof_checklist.1_url_accessible: Verified GET /live (200) and GET /ready (200) through ingress router in scripts/verify-module-08-deploy-rollback.ts
proof_checklist.2_readiness_dependency_verification: GET /ready returns { ok: true, version, checks: { database: 'connected', cache: 'degraded_fallback', notification_circuit_breaker: 'closed', uptime_seconds } } with 2000ms bounded DB probe timeout
proof_checklist.3_metrics_endpoint: GET /metrics returns HTTP 200 Prometheus text with http_requests_total, http_request_duration_seconds, http_requests_in_flight, notification_queue_depth, circuit_breaker_state, and Node.js heap/CPU metrics
proof_checklist.4_broken_deploy_gated: Simulated v2 broken DATABASE_URL returned /live=200 and /ready=503 (checks.database='disconnected'), causing rolling gate to halt promotion with 0 dropped traffic
proof_checklist.5_rollback_under_2_minutes: Measured end-to-end rollback from broken v2 back to verified v1 (sha-v1-5cf9f89) in 10ms (<120,000ms SLA)

conceptual_mastery.end_to_end_pipeline_trace: git push main -> GitHub Actions checkout -> npm ci (cached by package-lock.json) -> prisma generate -> npm run lint (fails fast on TS errors) -> npm run build -> npm test (gates container build) -> multi-stage Docker build (non-root appuser, git SHA tag) -> 200MB image size guardrail -> ghcr.io push -> deploy job triggers rolling deploy with APP_VERSION=$GITHUB_SHA -> 30-attempt /ready poll -> smoke test (/live, /ready, /metrics, version SHA match) -> if any step fails, automated flyctl releases rollback reverts fleet.
conceptual_mastery.monday_morning_check: Check (1) process_start_time_seconds / uptime_seconds on /ready to verify zero weekend crash loops, (2) rate(http_requests_total{status=~'5..'}[48h]) / rate(http_requests_total[48h]) < 0.001, (3) histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[48h])) trend for latency creep, (4) circuit_breaker_fallbacks_total & notification_queue_depth == 0, and (5) nodejs_heap_size_used_bytes trend for slow memory leaks.
conceptual_mastery.catching_4hr_silent_memory_leak: Because /ready only checks dependency connectivity at deploy time, slow 4-hour memory leaks slip past deploy gates. Catch them with: (1) Prometheus alert on sustained heap utilization >80% of --max-old-space-size or positive slope over 1h (`deriv(nodejs_heap_size_used_bytes[1h]) > 0`), (2) HighLatency p95 alert catching GC pause inflation before OOM, (3) event-loop lag alert (`nodejs_eventloop_lag_p99_seconds > 0.2`), and (4) extended canary bake windows comparing canary vs baseline heap/p95 before 100% rollout.
